title: Signal Heights
text: Snow, wind, and a plateau high enough that the sky is a darker blue at noon. A pinnacle in the north-west. In the south-east an old mast in our own pattern, half buried. Skimmerwings nest in the crags. They have noticed us already.

lines.text: "Get a Radar up and trace the report's carrier from the pinnacle. Then tell me I'm wrong. I've been hoping to be wrong since the recordings."
